mapper.select: SELECT a.*, d.device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS user_name FROM borrow_apply a LEFT JOIN device d ON a.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_apply(device_id, user_id, apply_reason, expected_return_time, apply_time, status) VALUES(#{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{applyReason}, #{expectedReturnTime}, #{applyTime}, #{status})
